# How hot should espresso water be?

The [Specialty Coffee Association](https://sca.coffee/research) recommends brewing water between 90 and 96 °C. Most home machines sit inside that window once they are fully warmed up.

## Do home machines run cooler than they claim?

A small study of home machines found that many ran cooler than their display showed ([Example Lab, 2024](https://example.org/home-machines)). The same report suggests letting the machine warm up for a while before the first shot.

## What should I do first?

Let the machine heat up fully, flush a little water through the group head, and taste a shot before changing anything else.
